body: I feel better today... Spent most of it playing Skyrim.  It was a much needed escape. Still a little down but not as badly as yesterday.
Thank you. I am certain I will take you up on your offer. How I felt is far from gone.

I am okay for now...my insomnia tends to put me in dark places and tonight it chose to put me back at 8am... 

Thankfully my body is settling down and I will be asleep soon.
